cycles.method: SPACE output-envelope implementation on parent 8ffef0f, package fef9db2b, card image 3ae08fe5 (2026-10-25). Static: scripts/space_static_cost.py uses the pinned SDK word-span model with only a forward-BRA parser extension in memory; target/direction checks, BSR accounting and marker byte identity retained. Loop 458 words plus two (23-word callee + 4 call/return) charges = 512/sample; overhead 94/call; two calls per 16-frame block = 8,380, four/core = 33,520 of 49,920. Raw SDK --verify refuses BRA, not reported passing. Measured: scripts/perf_record.py bench, same one-instance/core protocol as benchmark_stock_dsp.py, 4,096 blocks of 16 frames, null-stub peak subtracted; fixed, moving SPCE ramps/jumps/reopens, every split 1..15 and SPCE 1/32/64/96/127 held with every split. Worst 407.38 executed instructions/sample (SPCE 127 split 1), 405.06 unsplit; moving 404.25/406.56; held 1..96 costs 381.06 unsplit; SPCE 0 is -3.25 relative to null. make check raw 409.2/411.6; 412 declared (base 7/4 charge 721 of 726). Software counts without chip memory stalls.

stock.baseline: scripts/perf_record.py bench: SPRING REV, PLATE REV, DARK REV and DJ EQ on the stock image through the same cases as FRACT (fixed, the moving pattern, a trig split at every position 1-15). Their unsplit figures reproduce the SDK's out/stock_dsp_bench/results.json exactly (SPRING REV 257.5, PLATE REV 183.94, DARK REV 193.25, DJ EQ 293.38); with splits SPRING REV 314.19, PLATE REV 218.25, DARK REV 242.38, DJ EQ 330.94.
stock.justification: SPACE is a stereo reverb behind unchanged ColdFire grains: Mini Verb's four-branch feedback delay network, eight loop allpasses (two modulated), orthogonal Householder feedback, damping, feedback below .97, mid/side 40 Hz DC rejection, six input allpasses and true stereo excitation. Above 96, knee drive falls and damping follows the slewed mix; a linked mean-absolute output-envelope servo reduces replayed pluck swells without feeding the tank. Full 44.1 kHz. Worst 407.38 executed instructions/sample with split is 1.87x PLATE REV 218.25, 1.30x SPRING REV 314.19 and 1.23x DJ EQ 330.94. Granulation costs the DSP nothing. Exact dry costs one compare and return (-3.25 vs null). Four loops/core take 2,048 of 3,120 static cycles, leaving 1,072 before call overhead; full split allowance 33,520 of 49,920 cycles/block. Stress with CHORUS on every FX1 peaks at 2,789.6 and 2,767.8 executed instructions/sample/core. Silicon contention, deadline margin and several FRACT instances on a unit remain unmeasured; owner review required.

stress.method: scripts/perf_record.py stress --seconds 4, same direct DSP load as BBD's record because no Octatrack template project is available. Current card 3ae08fe5, payloads 78b9eaed/f15bb253. FRACT on all eight FX2 slots (four/core), CHORUS on all FX1 slots; three synthetic LFOs/track (POS, SIZE, SPCE) and random named values each sixteenth at 120 BPM: 18 slots, 12 lockable main controls, remaining SETUP controls driven directly. Only SPCE reaches FRACT's DSP; POS/SIZE belong to ColdFire, not executed here. Splits 1/3/7/8/12/15 on six tracks, eight 4-second stems plus 2-second tail, dsp_host -guard 15779 -guard-shared -dirty 0x5a. Host exit 0, no hangs, FRACT stray regions 0 / clobbers 0, all-instance clobbers 0; stock CHORUS has 2,339,107 stray regions under FRACT's smaller buffer guard (not its allocation, not investigated). Per-core peaks 2,789.6/2,767.8 executed instructions/sample; 140.6 seconds host time. Firmware control delivery, Part switches and ColdFire are outside this run; make cost-check prices ColdFire.

coldfire.note: Supplementary. The granulator runs on the ColdFire from the Modwerk base's uncached pool, outside this dsp record's schema. Figures: make cost-check (QEMU cfv4e against the host build, 0 mismatches), priced with the metric the user's MKII measured in M0 (docs/M0_MEASUREMENT.md): measured = 0.29 x pool code bytes + 1.99 x instructions + 16.8 x pool reads + 9.4 x pool writes, 958 measured cycles = 1 point of the base's CPU meter for a 16-frame block. Sample-arena reads are counted but not priced.
